name: Hyperbase
one_liner: Offline-first SQLite sync engine for edge web and mobile apps.

hard_problems.title: High-latency offline client reconciliation
hard_problems.description: Mobile field clients stay offline for 6-18 hours on 2G/3G networks and reconnect with hundreds of queued local SQLite mutations that conflict on shared records.

hard_problems.title: SQLite write contention under burst traffic
hard_problems.description: Single-writer SQLite locks spike p99 sync acknowledgement latency above 400ms whenever 300+ concurrent clients flush batches to the FastAPI ingest node.

hard_problems.title: Bandwidth and egress cost on flaky connections
hard_problems.description: Re-sending full state snapshots after mid-stream WebSocket disconnects triples mobile data usage and cloud egress bills.
